name: temper
description: Temper: an intent-gated SDLC for AI-generated code — intent, plan, design, build, review, check, commit, with every gate verdict computed by an auditable CLI rather than asserted by a model.

interface.shortDescription: Quality gates for AI-written code: intent to commit, every verdict computed.
interface.longDescription: Temper runs a gated SDLC over AI-generated code. A bash CLI reads an evidence ledger and computes PASS/FAIL per stage, and a native git pre-commit hook blocks the commit while any gate is red — so a gate verdict is never something the model asserts about its own work.
defaultPrompt: Run the Temper pipeline on this feature
Use the temper skill to plan and build this change behind quality gates
